C-GRACE-RECONCILE-2026-10.Name: Anti-drift reconciliation: archive ten executed change bundles, repair governance artifacts, absorb working-file drift
C-GRACE-RECONCILE-2026-10.Summary: The 2026-10-23 anti-drift audit compared all sixteen active change bundles against git history, release trains, the acceptance registry and physical artifacts. Ten of the eleven "ready-to-execute" bundles are already executed — most shipped inside tag v2.7.0 — but their folders remain active, which fabricates a 28-warning scope-overlap web, an unsafe-parallel verdict, and a misleading ready count. This bundle archives the ten with their evidence, repairs the one integrity error (unescaped angle brackets in an archived design-context), supersedes four stale evidence.json status fields, removes one accidental empty file, and commits the working files that already-shipped bundle specs reference by path.

Problem.Description: 1) Ten executed bundles stay in .grace/changes/active with approved plans, so grace status reports them as ready-to-execute and grace lint emits 28 scope.durable-overlap warnings plus parallel-preflight errors between bundles whose code is already merged and released. 2) .grace/changes/archive/C-SELF-CONTAINED-HTML-EXPORT/design-context.xml lines 23-24 contain literal <home>/<winhome> placeholders as raw angle brackets; the parse failure is the project's only integrity error and disables module-health navigation entirely. 3) Four evidence.json files still say "owner acceptance and commit pending" although acceptance (2026-10-22, docs/acceptance/registry.json) and release (tag v2.7.0) have since happened. 4) src-tauri/src/lib.rs is an untracked empty file (0 bytes) not used by any build; work/ holds three mockup files referenced by path from shipped bundle specs; docs/archive/screenshots/2026-09-asc-old-mark/ holds nine prepared archive files referenced by nothing. The ten PNG binaries cannot pass the fail-closed binary policy and remain untracked.

Goals.R-1: Archive the ten executed bundles (list in T-1) from active/ to archive/ with spec and plan status applied and a resolution evidence trail per bundle.
Goals.R-2: Repair design-context.xml lines 23-24 by escaping the literal placeholders; module-health loads again and grace lint reports zero errors.
Goals.R-3: Supersede the stale evidence.json status fields with dated resolution records citing commit, PR, acceptance-registry and tag evidence.
Goals.R-4: Absorb file drift: delete the empty src-tauri/src/lib.rs; commit the two text work/ mockups (spec-referenced). The ten PNG binaries (nine ASC archive screenshots plus work/recently-closed-tabs-mockup.png) stay uncommitted: the fail-closed publication policy permits only manifest-bound docs/assets/readme screenshots, and the safety gate blocks every other binary path pending a sanctioned local multimodal review — the owner's chosen path for them is a recorded follow-up.

C-GRACE-RECONCILE-2026-10.ScopeDecision: Owner 2026-10-23 approved items 1-3 of the proposed reconciliation ("1-3 ок"). The disposition of C-50 (backlog feature vs retired annotation) and the archival of retired drafts C-23/C-35 are deliberately excluded and await a separate owner decision.

Constraints.Constraint: No product code changes: nothing under src/, src-tauri/ shipped sources, static/ runtime locales or tools/ runtime behavior is modified.
The parallel session's in-flight release-materials edits (version files, locales, What's New, tests, README, CHANGELOG, screenshot refresh) stay unstaged and untouched by this bundle's commit.
Dispositions for C-23, C-35, C-36, C-37, C-47 and C-50 are excluded pending the owner's decision.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Any product code change; nothing in src/, src-tauri/ shipped sources, static/ or tools/ runtime behavior is touched.
Dispositions for C-23, C-35, C-36, C-37, C-47 and C-50.
Release-train admission: this change is governance bookkeeping with no user-facing surface.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: grace lint --path . --assertions current reports 0 errors and no new warning classes; grace status module-health loads (no moduleHealthLoadError).
grace status --with modules --json lists the ten bundles under archive with specStatus applied; active/ contains only the five parked drafts, C-50 and no others.
grace lint --parallel-preflight reports no observed-write or durable-overlap errors among remaining active bundles.
git status is clean of the previous untracked entries; the committed tree contains work/ mockups and the ASC screenshots; the empty lib.rs is gone.

AffectedAreas.Governance: .grace/changes/{active,archive}/ for the ten bundles plus this one; .grace/changes/archive/C-SELF-CONTAINED-HTML-EXPORT/design-context.xml

C-GRACE-RECONCILE-2026-10.VerificationIntent: grace lint --assertions current; grace status --with modules --json (module-health present, archive counts); grace lint --parallel-preflight; git log v2.6.0..v2.7.0 and docs/acceptance/registry.json as the evidence trail cited by the resolution records.

Approval.ApprovedBy: owner (2026-10-23, chat): approved items 1-3 of the anti-drift reconciliation proposal; item 4 (C-50 / C-23 / C-35 dispositions) explicitly deferred pending explanation.
Approval.ApprovalScope: Items 1-3 only: archival of the ten executed bundles, XML and evidence repairs, drift absorption. No C-50/C-23/C-35 action.
